actual_dose_expectation: Parent R19_v2 measured response is the baseline: point_rms_A fell 0.43339353799819946 -> 0.18311063945293427 (mean 0.27596569024026396) with atom_clip_fraction 0.0 and cumulative_clip_fraction 0.0, dose_gain_mean 1.0, requested_rms_A_mean 0.02995916032232344, injected_rms_A_mean 0.029959160136058927, raw/current gradient_rms_mean 0.007972290541511029, assignment_switch_fraction mean 0.016333334046439864, 40 active/nonzero updates. A000 keeps the same dose configuration (max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, field_sigma_A 1.5, lookahead_fraction 0.2, mode_memory_t 0.05, switch_margin_A 0.15, advantage_cap 20.0, density_scale_floor [0.03,0.1,0.1,0.1]) and constant schedule with schedule_normalization 1.0, so the expected per-step requested displacement stays at the parent scale (~0.030 A RMS) and the expected effect is a further decrease of point_rms_A for slots [4,14,15] below the parent trajectory toward the 0.35 A band, with no atom clipping. Time schedule acts on the normalized requested displacement; the positive reward coefficient is subject to gradient normalization, so the declared quantity is the actual post-normalization displacement, not the raw reward magnitude. Reaching the band is a necessary condition only: parent evidence shows forming the N geometry did not by itself produce a high-scoring tail (best_qualified_pic50 8.590141296386719, n_above_target 0, hit_fraction 0.02, n_qualified 48, n_scored 50, mean_all_pic50 7.71079755783081, U_tau 0.009101848602294921, tau 8.135048866271973), so a positive result requires both band attainment and a terminal-affinity improvement over the parent.
derivative_path: Reward is computed on real model-coordinate VJP only; the assignment branch is detached (sensing: detached), so pi only changes the matched geometric correspondence and does not directly differentiate logits or element identity. E0 matching is separated from E1 (stop-gradient probability/space field) and E2 (probability/space joint coordinate VJP); no affinity-head derivative and no per-step extra affinity inference are introduced. Routing is single and does not stop gradient on the coordinate path; state-dependent weights are not differentiated, so only conditional routing gradient is claimed, not an exact derivative of a full mixed potential. Hard category/chemical-graph identification is used only for gradient-free routing. Element, charge and necessary bond information come from the existing generation head; formal charge is a separate channel and is not asserted to be partial charge, pKa or interaction free energy. The model VJP is valid only for the current call, not for all future stochastic generations.
design_grounds: Analyst G000 binds the terminal-success signal to the three-slot aromatic C/C/N interface (slots 4,14,15) with orientation triplet [15,4,14] and a donor terminal N; the ancestor record supplies both the actual current world coordinates and the same-forward teacher predicted endpoint for exactly these slots, so the residual is small and measurable. A000 is the only registered option whose region_ids match this support, and it carries the needed direction neighbors (full_adjacency: 4->[10,15,24], 14->[11,15,23], 15->[4,14]) so the support stays strictly local. The competing queried region interface19 has only two slots, no orientation triplet, and an O donor/acceptor pair without a directional constraint, so it is retained only as the matched-control falsifier, not as the selected support. Counterevidence is registered: the conditional layout test found zero identifiable signed interactions and native-minus-alternate mean only 0.076, and the prior campaign shows N formation (95.8% geometric match) with best_qualified_pic50 only 8.127753, so the support is not proven to be the causal carrier of terminal success. No points, mode sources or terms are added; the detached element-assignment cost (c=0.5) only changes which slots are matched and does not differentiate logits or element identity.
falsifier: Falsified if, with the same support [4,14,15] and the same dose, the three-slot predictive-bridge reward fails to reduce point_rms_A below the parent R19_v2 trajectory (i.e. does not go below 0.18311063945293427 at the learning end), or if it reaches the 0.35 A band but the terminal-affinity distribution does not improve over the parent (no increase in best_qualified_pic50 above 8.590141296386719 and no increase in the qualified tail / n_above_target). A second falsifier is a matched control on the two-slot O region F_b011_s030__v3_interface19 producing the same or larger effect, which would show the effect is not specific to this aromatic C/C/N support. Band attainment alone must not be reported as value. Interface errors are recorded separately from scientific negative results; numerically identical functions reuse existing results and frozen confirmation introduces no new design.
operative_terms: Single mode, single routing, scope local, operator pointwise, family ancestral_modes_v3, program_id R15_V3_COMPATIBLE.
